summary: Net Lease Office Properties filed an 8-K reporting the adjournment of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders to June 25, 2026, to allow additional time for proxy solicitation. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR all proposals. No changes were made to the proposals. This is a routine procedural adjournment of an annual meeting, not a special situation event. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activity.
